description: Voices Ania Studio can narrate with, with language (pt-BR, en-US) and gender (Kokoro Alex is the default). A voice that fails never gets swapped silently: the render stops, nothing is charged, and the user decides (see studio_renderizar trocar_voz_se_falhar). Each voice has `amostra`: a ~6 s pre-recorded sample (mp3 link) to let the user hear it before choosing; studio_testar_voz makes it say the user’s own sentence (free). Each catalogue voice has `status` (estado disponivel | limitada | fora | sem_checagem, motivo, verificadoEm): a limited or down voice may stop the render, so tell the user before rendering. `minhas` lists the user’s own Piper voices (trained on Ania or bought on the model marketplace; only they can use them), id `minha-<id>`; the user hears those on the site page in `amostra`. Pass the id to studio_criar_projeto. Free.

language.description: Always pass it: the language the user is writing in right now, as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'), not the app's interface language. Replies, prices and the card follow it.
